title: Oozing French Tofu Galette
description: A savory, gooey vegan galette with tofu, tomato sauce, and a cornstarch glaze, perfect for midnight cravings.
instructions: Press the tofu for 30 minutes then cube it.
In a bowl mix the tofu cubes with 30g flour, 15g cornstarch, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp soy sauce until coated.
Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large skillet over medium heat, add the tofu mixture and cook 6-8 minutes, flipping until golden and crisp.
Remove the tofu to a plate and set aside; add the remaining 1 tbsp oil to the same skillet and sauté the diced onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic, thyme, and tomato paste to the onion and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in 200ml water, stir to combine, and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Return the tofu to the skillet, stir to coat with the sauce, and simmer for 4 minutes.
Increase the heat to high and let the sauce reduce until slightly thickened, about 3 minutes.
Serve the galette hot, spooning extra sauce over the tofu and optionally garnish with parsley.
Enjoy while still warm for the best gooey texture.
